creative.glide.label: Flight drift
creative.glide.description: 0 stops immediately when movement keys are released. 5 uses full modern-style drift.

creative.doubleTapTicks.label: Double-tap window, ticks
creative.doubleTapTicks.description: Maximum interval between Jump presses. 20 ticks is one second.

creative.modePicker.label: Gamemode picker
creative.modePicker.description: Hold F3, press F4 to cycle, then release F3 to select.

creative.spectatorScroll.label: Scroll to change speed
creative.spectatorScroll.description: Adjust spectator flight speed with the mouse wheel.

creative.showSpectatorSpeed.label: Show spectator speed
creative.showSpectatorSpeed.description: Display the current speed while it changes.

creative.spectatorScrollStep.label: Speed step, %
creative.spectatorScrollStep.description: Speed change for each wheel step.

creative.blockReach.label: Block reach
creative.blockReach.description: Reach in blocks. Only applies in Creative.

creative.entityReach.label: Entity reach
creative.entityReach.description: Reach in blocks. Only applies in Creative.

creative.destroySlot.label: Destroy slot
creative.destroySlot.description: Drag items to the slot beside the hotbar to delete them.

creative.shiftClearsInventory.label: Shift-click clears inventory
creative.shiftClearsInventory.description: Shift-click the destroy slot to clear inventory and armor.

worldedit.enabled.label: World editing
worldedit.enabled.description: Allow editing commands and the wand when Cheats enabled is on in this world.

worldedit.blockLimit.label: Maximum blocks per edit
worldedit.blockLimit.description: Reject edits above this limit before making changes.

worldedit.blocksPerTick.label: Blocks processed per tick
worldedit.blocksPerTick.description: Lower values keep large edits responsive.

worldedit.historySize.label: Undo history
worldedit.historySize.description: Maximum number of edit records kept in memory.

tweaks.placement.enabled.label: Fast placement
tweaks.placement.enabled.description: Hold right-click to keep placing blocks.

tweaks.placement.attemptsPerTick.label: Placement attempts per tick
tweaks.placement.attemptsPerTick.description: Maximum placement attempts per game tick.

tweaks.placement.slabMode.label: Vertical slab placement
tweaks.placement.slabMode.description: Continuous layers, double slabs, or repeat the first slab configuration.

tweaks.placement.rememberOrientation.label: Remember orientation
tweaks.placement.rememberOrientation.description: Keep the initial orientation during continuous placement.

tweaks.placement.restrictionEnabled.label: Placement restriction
tweaks.placement.restrictionEnabled.description: Constrain continued placement using the first successful placement.

tweaks.placement.restrictionTiedToFast.label: Tie restriction to fast placement
tweaks.placement.restrictionTiedToFast.description: Turning fast placement on or off also changes the restriction switch.

tweaks.placement.restrictionMode.label: Restriction rule
tweaks.placement.restrictionMode.description: Face, plane, layer, column, line or diagonal.

tweaks.placement.listMode.label: Item filter
tweaks.placement.listMode.description: Choose whether to allow all items, exclude listed items, or only allow listed items.

tweaks.placement.blacklist.label: Excluded items
tweaks.placement.blacklist.description: Item IDs separated by commas, for example 1, 44:2.

tweaks.placement.whitelist.label: Allowed items
tweaks.placement.whitelist.description: Item IDs separated by commas, for example 1, 44:2. An empty allow-list permits nothing.

tweaks.hotbar.swap.label: Swap hotbar rows
tweaks.hotbar.swap.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.scroll.label: Scroll to choose a row
tweaks.hotbar.scroll.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.numberRowKeys.label: Modifier + number selects row
tweaks.hotbar.numberRowKeys.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.overlay.label: Row preview
tweaks.hotbar.overlay.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.reverseScroll.label: Reverse row scrolling
tweaks.hotbar.reverseScroll.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.rememberRow.label: Remember the selected row
tweaks.hotbar.rememberRow.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.selectedRow.label: Starting row
tweaks.hotbar.selectedRow.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.alignment.label: Preview alignment
tweaks.hotbar.alignment.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.offsetX.label: Horizontal offset
tweaks.hotbar.offsetX.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.hotbar.offsetY.label: Vertical offset
tweaks.hotbar.offsetY.description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

tweaks.clickMining.label: Continuous click mining
tweaks.clickMining.description: Remove the delay between breaking blocks in singleplayer.

tweaks.boatSteering.label: Boat steering
tweaks.boatSteering.description: Steer boats directly using movement keys. Speed and collision protection are separate.

tweaks.sneak.enabled.label: Edge protection
tweaks.sneak.enabled.description: Prevent walking off ledges without crouching or slowing down.

logo.logo.lines.label: Title lettering
logo.logo.lines.description: Rows use the letter block palette. Spaces leave gaps.

power_controls:features.eatingSounds.label: Eating sounds
power_controls:features.eatingSounds.description: Play chewing when food is consumed.

power_controls:features.shearingSounds.label: Shearing sounds
power_controls:features.shearingSounds.description: Play a snip when a sheep is successfully sheared.

power_controls:features.toolBreakSounds.label: Tool break sounds
power_controls:features.toolBreakSounds.description: Play a sound when a tool reaches zero durability.

power_controls:features.armorBreakSounds.label: Armor break sounds
power_controls:features.armorBreakSounds.description: Play a sound when an armor piece breaks.

power_controls:features.chestSounds.label: Chest sounds
power_controls:features.chestSounds.description: Play sounds when opening and closing chests.

tweaks.boatSpeed.label: Faster boats
tweaks.boatSpeed.description: Raise the boat speed limit independently of steering.

tweaks.boatProtection.label: Boat collision protection
tweaks.boatProtection.description: Prevent boats from breaking when they hit blocks.

power_camera:config.enabled.label: Freecam
power_camera:config.enabled.description: Allow the detached camera and its controls.

power_camera:config.doorCollision.label: Freecam door collisions
power_camera:config.doorCollision.description: With camera collisions enabled, also collide with doors and trapdoors. Off passes through them.

power_camera:config.sprint.label: Freecam sprint
power_camera:config.sprint.description: Boost camera speed with the flight sprint key. Uses the creative sprint multiplier and Hold/Toggle setting.

visual.slashChat.label: Slash opens chat
visual.slashChat.description: Open chat with / already entered when pressing the slash key.

visual.containerCarry.label: Move containers
visual.containerCarry.description: Sneak and use an empty hand to carry a chest, furnace or dispenser. Target either half of a double chest to move only that half. Contents are journaled for recovery.

visual.containerPreview.label: Container preview
visual.containerPreview.description: Hold the container-preview key while aiming at a container to view its contents without opening it.

power_compat:config.addBlockLightToDebug.label: Block light
power_compat:config.addBlockLightToDebug.description: Exact block-emitted light at your feet, from 0 to 15. Excludes sunlight and screen brightness.

visual.swapEquipment.label: Swap tools and armour
visual.swapEquipment.description: Click matching tools or armour with different durability to swap them. Singleplayer only; slot restrictions still apply.

tweaks.autoWalkHoldToWalk.label: Hold auto-walk key to walk
tweaks.autoWalkHoldToWalk.description: Tap to toggle walking. Hold beyond the threshold to stop walking when released.
